Central Library & Digital Archives

Books, Research Journals, HEC Digital Library & Quiet Study Lounges at University of Loralai

HEC Recognized Digital Repository

Gateway to World-Class Academic Knowledge

The Central Library at Zerh Karez campus provides a state-of-the-art learning environment with over 25,000 physical volumes, access to the Higher Education Commission (HEC) National Digital Library, and online DIMS cataloging.

Services Provided at UOLI Library

Supporting research scholars, undergraduate students, and faculty with comprehensive library facilities.

Circulation & Borrowing

Automated RFID book circulation system. Students can issue, renew, and reserve textbooks using their student ID cards.

HEC Digital Library Access

High-speed campus network access to international research repositories including IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, and JSTOR.

Quiet Research Lounges

Dedicated silent study halls, individual reading cubicles, and group discussion rooms equipped with Wi-Fi and power outlets.
